name: switch-trust-cc-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin for the Switch Trust platform. Reports Claude Code usage & computed cost to Switch Trust for cost tracking and further analysis.

switch_trust_api_key.title: Switch Trust API Key
switch_trust_api_key.description: Your Switch Trust API key (sk_...). Determines which tenant/workspace usage is reported to.

switch_trust_environment.title: Switch Trust Ingestion Endpoint
switch_trust_environment.description: Base URL of the Switch Trust ingestion service. Leave as the default unless directed to use staging or a local endpoint.

switch_trust_mode.title: Report Mode
switch_trust_mode.description: How much conversation detail to report. Default is full (real prompts, responses, and tool calls/results — needed for Switch Trust's ROI recommendations). condensed sends token counts only, text adds prompt/response text, none disables reporting.

switch_trust_user_email.title: User Email Override
switch_trust_user_email.description: Override the per-user identity used for attribution. Leave unset to auto-detect locally (git config user.email, then OS login name) -- no cloud credentials are used.
